summary: Joseph Walser works in Buddhist studies and Indology. He studied under Isshi Yamada, Adolf von Wuertenburg, and David S. Pacini.
Joseph Zalman Margolis was a philosopher who earned an M.A. from Columbia University by 1950. He taught Youru Wang and held the Laura H. Carnell Chair of Philosophy at Temple University in 1991.

Joseph von Hammer-Purgstall worked in Iranian and Central Asian studies and history/archaeology. He studied at the K.k. Akademie für Orientalische Sprachen (~1789–1799), taught Friedrich Rückert, and held a post at the Austrian Academy of Sciences (~1847–1849).
Josho Nozawa was a scholar of Buddhist studies, Indology, and Tibetology who studied under Susumu Yamaguchi. He held a professorship at Koyasan University, attested in 1950.
Joshua Ereshefsky works in Buddhist and religious studies. Attested in 2026, he is a PhD candidate in religious studies at McMaster University under the doctoral supervision of James A. Benn.
Joshua Marshman was an Indologist, sinologist, and linguist. He studied at Bristol Baptist College (~1794–1799) and under Hovhannes Ghazarian (~1806–1812), and founded Serampore College in 1818.

Joshua Timothy Katz is a linguist who earned degrees at Yale, Oxford, and Harvard. He was Cotsen Professor in the Humanities at Princeton University (1998–2022) and became a Senior Fellow at the American Enterprise Institute.
Joshua W. C. Cutler specializes in Tibetology and Buddhist studies. He studied under Geshe Wangyal and held a post at the Tibetan Buddhist Learning Center, attested in 2004.

Josiah Royce was a philosopher who studied at UC Berkeley, Göttingen under Hermann Lotze, and Johns Hopkins. He taught at UC Berkeley (~1878–1882) and served on the Harvard University faculty from 1882 to 1916.

José Ignacio Cabezón specializes in Buddhist studies, Tibetology, and philosophy. He studied at Caltech, UW–Madison under Geshe Lhundub Sopa, and Sera Monastery. He held posts at Iliff School of Theology and UC Santa Barbara.
Jotika Khur-Yearn is a scholar of Buddhist studies. He completed a PhD at SOAS University of London under the doctoral supervision of Kate Crosby, attested in 2012.

Jowita Kramer works in Indology, Buddhist studies, and Tibetology. She studied at Hamburg under Lambert Schmithausen and Munich under Jens-Uwe Hartmann, held posts at Munich, Heidelberg, and Göttingen, and became a professor at Leipzig University in 2021.
Joy Brennan works in Buddhist studies, philosophy, and sinology. She earned a PhD at the University of Chicago, where she studied under Paul Mendes-Flohr, Richard A. Rosengarten, and Constance Furey.

Joyce Burkhalter Flueckiger is a scholar of Indology and religious studies who studied at Goshen College and the University of Wisconsin-Madison. She held a faculty post at Emory University (~1992–2023), where she is Professor Emerita.
Juan Wu is a scholar of Buddhist studies and Indology. She completed a PhD at Cardiff University under the doctoral supervision of Max Deeg, attested in 2012.

Judit Torzsok is an Indologist who completed her DPhil at Oxford under Alexis Sanderson. She was an associate professor at Charles de Gaulle University – Lille III in 2001 and became a professor at the École Pratique des Hautes Études in 2018.

Judith Simmer-Brown works in Buddhist, Tibetan, and religious studies. She studied under Chögyam Trungpa and earned degrees from Cornell College, Florida State, and Walden University. She has been on the faculty of Naropa University since 1977.

Juha Pentikäinen is a scholar of religious studies who studied at the University of Helsinki and the University of Turku. He served as Professor of Comparative Religion at the University of Helsinki from ~1972 to 2008.

Juhn Y. Ahn is a Buddhist studies scholar who earned a PhD from the University of California, Berkeley in 2007. He served as Associate Professor of Buddhist and Korean Studies at the University of Michigan, attested in 2019.

Juhyung Rhi specializes in Buddhist studies, art history, and Indology. He earned a PhD from the University of California, Berkeley and became Professor of Art History at Seoul National University in 1992.
